method: Read source/test and parse AST without import/exec; stream frozen hashes and verify saved integer/map/cycle metadata only. No selected/full source face or coordinate rows decoded; no extractor, tests, scientific/native/Docker/geometry/Git/API/network call.

prepared_test_scope.coverage: Actual stdlib module byte helpers: subset integer reindex/order/origins, identity-map row, negative zero and near-distinct binary64 preservation, full readback/corruption refusal, fixed-face moving-map refusal and original-source immutability.

source_read_checks.fixed_face_rule: All38 fixed IDs must belong to the complete cap. Their actual source triangle vertices are required to map to themselves before data construction/writes. This mandatory guard is source-reviewed; actual fixed vertex rows were not decoded by this reviewer.
source_read_checks.fresh_and_failure_protocol: Exact supplied contract SHA, separate root/peer authority, extractor/interpreter/input hashes, canonical direct-child fresh output path with symlink refusal, mkdir/open-x and before/after source/contract/runtime checks. Partial outputs are retained and cannot be automatically reused.
source_read_checks.full_readback: Compare every emitted byte of all five data files to constructed bytes, then decode both origin arrays and every emitted coordinate/oriented face row to compare against the corresponding actual source row. The map/fixed files are included in complete byte equality.
source_read_checks.integer_reindex_provenance: Increasing global vertex/face row IDs define local tables. Every triangle corner maps through the local-ID table in the original source corner order. Local→global arrays refer to d2af row IDs only; no original Porsche/894 lineage is invented.
source_read_checks.manifest: Only after full readback and unchanged pins, write exclusive manifest binding all five data hashes/sizes/counts/cycles; manifest intentionally excludes its own hash map. No successful manifest is written after a caught failure.
source_read_checks.no_geometry_application: Only raw coordinate copy/integer reindexing/separate map serialization. No cap quotient application, quality calculation, CDT, native operation or new point construction.
source_read_checks.separate_complete_map: Every disjoint group contributes all members including keeper→keeper. Sorted local old/keeper pairs preserve completeness, one identity per group and idempotence. The cap.bin builder uses original source rows/local reindexing only, never the keeper map.
source_read_checks.source_SURF1_rows: Exact8-byte magic/little-endian uint64 header/byte length; sorted unique face IDs and valid three-distinct source indices. Global counts/cap3508V3508F checked against held expectations before writes. Selected coordinates are validated finite numeric-z0 but copied as opaque24-byte strings, preserving negative zero and every binary64 bit.
